title: SceneObject
description: A single element of a scanned room: a surface (wall/floor/ceiling/door/window) or a detected physical object. Modeled after Meta Quest's Scene API / MRUK semantic classifications, but kept engine-neutral.

SemanticLabel.description: What kind of real-world element this object represents.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. the originating spatial anchor UUID.

parentId.description: id of the containing object (e.g. a room), or null for top-level objects.

boundary.description: Set for planar surfaces (floor, ceiling, walls, doors, windows).

volume.description: Set for volumetric objects (furniture) instead of, or in addition to, boundary.
